Instrument.description: What the tab is for. It sets how many strings it may have.

anyOf.description: The value itself, in the parameter's unit.
One of a choice's options, by name.

ParamValue.description: A parameter's value: a number, a choice's option by name, or a switch.

bypassed.description: Bypassed, the signal goes round the pedal; it keeps its settings.

params.description: Parameter values by the pedal format's id or the pedal's label, case aside. One left out starts at its default.

pedal.description: What it is: a stock name (`overdrive`), `cab:<impulse id>`, `pedal:<designed pedal id>`, `au:…` or `clap:…`.

state.description: A plugin's saved state, base64, applied before `params`.

description: A chain of pedals with their settings: a name, a genre, a line on what it sounds like, the instrument it suits, the input gain it expects and the pedals in order. Pedals are named as a project names them (a stock name, `cab:<impulse>`, `pedal:<id>`, `au:…`, `clap:…`) and their parameters by id or label.

description.description: One line on what it sounds like.

genre.description: The style it is for, as the picker groups rigs: `Metal`, `Rock`, `Blues`…

inputGainDb.description: Gain in decibels before the first pedal, −24 to 24: how hot the rig wants its input. The instrument profile trims it further in the app.

instrument.description: What it is for: a guitar or a bass.
